title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Monthly Fee: Seat Amount and Billed Seats
content:
**1. Minimum-commitment floor.** The floor of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is its contracted seats multiplied by the tier's minimum seat commitment percentage and divided by 100, rounded up to a whole seat.

**2. Billed seats.** The billed seats are the greater of the agreement's seat count and that floor.

**3. Seat amount and fee.** The seat amount is the per-seat rate multiplied by the billed seats, and the monthly fee is that seat amount rounded half up to the cent.

**4. Order of assembly.** The seat amount is fixed first. Any percentage credits on the monthly fee are then added into one combined percentage, applied once to the seat amount and rounded half up to the cent. Flat charges are added last.

The inputs are read from the agreement itself (its contracted seats, seat count and per-seat rate) and from its tier's minimum seat commitment percentage in the rate card.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** An agreement of 60 contracted seats on a tier whose commitment is 90 percent, at 130.00 per seat:

| Seat count | Floor | Billed seats | Seat amount | Monthly fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | 60 times 90 divided by 100, that is 54 | 54 | 7020.00 | 7020.00 |
| 58 | 54 | 58 | 7540.00 | 7540.00 |

With 45 contracted seats at 85 percent, the product 38.25 rounds up to a floor of 39 seats; at a per-seat rate of 92.37 and a seat count of 36, 39 seats are billed and the fee is 3602.43.
